name: New Zealand Bhikkhuni Sangha Trust
reason: Too thin: its Events, Visiting and Dhamma Talks pages are 'under construction', the latest news is from April 2025, there are no current offerings, and the only items are a library and two talks by its spiritual director embedded from Santi Forest Monastery's channel. Possible future listing once its Hamilton vihara programme is published; Ajahn Brahmali appears only in a video message on the home page, not as a teacher there.
